statement: CREATE TABLE values_test (n BIGINT, label TEXT, enabled BOOLEAN, payload JSON)
SELECT n,label,enabled,payload FROM values_test ORDER BY _id
CREATE TABLE scalar_test (minimum BIGINT, maximum BIGINT, ratio DOUBLE PRECISION, recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ)
SELECT n FROM values_test WHERE n=$1
CREATE TABLE threads (id TEXT, project_id TEXT, archived BOOLEAN, recency_at_ms BIGINT, preview TEXT)
CREATE INDEX threads_by_recency ON threads (archived, recency_at_ms DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS threads_by_recency ON threads (id)
CREATE INDEX visible_threads ON threads (recency_at_ms DESC) WHERE preview <> ''
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX threads_identity ON threads (id)
SELECT id FROM threads WHERE NOT archived ORDER BY recency_at_ms DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO history_items (_id,thread_id,body,payload) VALUES ('h1','t1','alpha memory',CAST('null' AS JSONB)),('h2','t2','alpha history',NULL),('h3','t3','alpha archived',NULL),('h4','t1','unrelated',CAST('{"amount":9007199254740993.0,"fraction":0.123456789012345678901}' AS JSONB))
SELECT _id,payload IS NULL FROM antfly_search('history_items','body:alpha') ORDER BY _id
SELECT payload ->> 'amount' AS amount,payload ->> 'fraction' AS fraction FROM antfly_search('history_items','body:unrelated')
SELECT s._id,t.id,s.score > 0 AS ranked FROM antfly_search('history_items',$1,50) AS s JOIN threads t ON t.id=s.thread_id WHERE t.project_id=$2 AND NOT t.archived ORDER BY s.score DESC,s._id LIMIT 20
SELECT _id FROM antfly_search('history_items',$1,$2) ORDER BY score DESC,_id LIMIT 1
SELECT s._id,t.id FROM antfly_search('search_vectors',$1,10) s JOIN threads t ON t.id=s.thread_id WHERE NOT t.archived ORDER BY s.score DESC,s._id LIMIT 1
SELECT _id FROM antfly_search('search_vectors',$1,10) ORDER BY score DESC,_id LIMIT 1

CREATE TABLE search_ranks (id TEXT, rank DOUBLE PRECISION)

SELECT id,rank > 0 FROM search_ranks ORDER BY id

CREATE TABLE publication_parent(n BIGINT PRIMARY KEY)

CREATE TABLE boolean_partial (n BIGINT, archived BOOLEAN)
CREATE INDEX boolean_visible ON boolean_partial(n DESC) WHERE NOT archived
SELECT n FROM boolean_partial WHERE n >= 0 AND archived = false ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT n FROM boolean_partial WHERE n >= 0 AND archived = false ORDER BY n DESC
CREATE INDEX boolean_not_true ON boolean_partial(n DESC) WHERE archived IS NOT TRUE
